drivers: Refinery outages at Deer Park and Vizag, but coker restarts elsewhere
Petcoke rally above US$100 on energy complex
Freight squeeze leaves heavy oil glut in the Americas
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mixed: small refinery outages are offset by coker restarts and limited fire impact. The price is down 16% over 3 months, and the quantitative score is near zero, so there is no clear shortage signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how long the Deer Park outage lasts and whether US Gulf Coast freight rates ease.
outlooks.summary_zh: 消息面多空交织:个别炼厂停产被焦化装置复产和火灾影响有限所抵消。价格近3个月下跌16%,量化评分接近零,缺乏明确的短缺信号。
drivers_zh: Deer Park和Vizag炼厂出现停产,但其他焦化装置已复产
能源板块走强,石油焦升至100美元以上
运费高企导致美洲重质油过剩
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注Deer Park炼厂停产持续时间,以及美国墨西哥湾沿岸运费是否回落。

drivers: DRC export quotas: Glencore cobalt output down 52%
Chinese miner suspends DR Congo operations
China export-control pause extended to 2027 (bearish)
outlooks.summary: DRC quotas are cutting output sharply and a Chinese miner has suspended operations, which supports tightness. The price fell 24% in 3 months, so some of the risk may be priced in, but the China pause extension eases part of the pressure.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for DRC quota adjustments and the Chinese miner's restart status in Congo.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额大幅压减产量,一家中国矿企暂停运营,支撑供应偏紧。价格近3个月下跌24%,部分风险或已消化;中国延长管制暂停期则缓解了部分压力。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额:嘉能可钴产量下降52%
中国矿企暂停刚果(金)业务
中国出口管制暂停延长至2027年(利空)
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)配额调整以及该中国矿企在当地的复产情况。

drivers: Copper-moly giant slows molybdenum output growth
Mining inspections in China
Price already up 18% in 3 months
outlooks.summary: Slower output growth from a major producer and Chinese mine inspections point to tight supply. The price is already up sharply, so part of this is priced in, but the supply score is the highest among the metals bar tin.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's mining inspection results and major producers' output guidance.
outlooks.summary_zh: 主要生产商放缓钼产量增长,加之中国矿山检查,供应偏紧。价格已大幅上涨,部分因素已被消化,但供应压力评分仍较高。
drivers_zh: 铜钼巨头放缓钼产量增长
中国矿山检查
价格近3个月已上涨18%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国矿山检查结果以及主要生产商的产量指引。

drivers: India bans black mass exports
Zimbabwe keeps January 2027 lithium export ban
China export-control pause extended (bearish)
outlooks.summary: New export bans in India and Zimbabwe add modest supply restrictions. Price is down 13% over 3 months, and China's pause extension limits the upside, so the signal is only moderate.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Zimbabwe's January 2027 export ban implementation and any Chinese policy change.
outlooks.summary_zh: 印度和津巴布韦的新出口禁令略微收紧供应。价格近3个月下跌13%,且中国延长暂停期限制了上行空间,信号仅为中等。
drivers_zh: 印度禁止黑粉出口
津巴布韦维持2027年1月锂出口禁令
中国出口管制暂停延长(利空)
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦2027年1月出口禁令的落实情况以及中国政策变化。

drivers: Japan yttrium supplies 'stalled'
China export controls on Japan
China extends export pause to January 2027 (bearish)
outlooks.summary: Yttrium shortages in Japan and targeted Chinese controls are real supply stress. China's two-month pause extension eases the broad risk, but the pause is short and the shortage in specific elements persists.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether China extends the pause beyond January 2027 and whether yttrium flows to Japan resume.
outlooks.summary_zh: 日本钇供应短缺及中国的针对性管制构成实际供应压力。中国将暂停期延长两个月缓解了整体风险,但期限较短,个别元素的短缺仍在。
drivers_zh: 日本钇供应“停滞”
中国对日本实施出口管制
中国将出口暂停期延长至2027年1月(利空)
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国是否在2027年1月后继续延长暂停期,以及对日钇供应是否恢复。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeeze supply
Tin demand growth outpacing refined supply
Price up 56% over 12 months
outlooks.summary: Congo conflict and Indonesian cuts are tightening supply while demand outpaces refined output. The price is up 1% over 3 months after a big 12-month rise, so further upside is plausible but some is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export volumes and security in eastern Congo near the Bisie mine.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产收紧供应,而需求增速超过精炼锡供应。价格近3个月持平微涨1%,但12个月涨幅较大,进一步上行有可能,但部分已被消化。
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产挤压供应
锡需求增长快于精炼供应
价格12个月上涨56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口量以及刚果东部Bisie矿区附近的安全形势。

drivers: Export deadline nears
China export-control pause extended (bearish)
Price down 56% over 12 months
outlooks.summary: Export policy risks exist, but China's pause was extended and new processing capacity is being announced. The price is down 5% over 3 months and 56% over 12, so there is no clear shortage signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the export deadline and any Chinese policy change after the pause.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口政策存在风险,但中国延长了暂停期,且新的加工产能正在公布。价格近3个月下跌5%、12个月下跌56%,缺乏明确的短缺信号。
drivers_zh: 出口期限临近
中国出口管制暂停延长(利空)
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注出口期限以及暂停期结束后中国的政策变化。

drivers: China's November 27 deadline and export-control reviews
Rising indium prices and tight minor metals
Price up 67% in 3 months
outlooks.summary: Chinese export deadlines and tight minor-metal markets keep supply risk high, with demand from chips and GaN adding support. The price has already jumped 67% in 3 months, so part of the shortage is priced in, but extension of the pause offers some relief.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's November 27 deadline and any licensing decisions for gallium and germanium.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国出口期限和小金属市场偏紧使供应风险居高不下,芯片和氮化镓需求也提供支撑。价格近3个月已大涨67%,部分短缺已被消化,暂停期延长带来一定缓解。
drivers_zh: 中国11月27日期限及出口管制审查
铟价上涨,小金属市场偏紧
价格近3个月上涨67%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国11月27日的期限以及镓、锗的许可决定。

drivers: Refinery outages offset by coker restarts
Petcoke rally and higher anode prices
Freight squeeze on US exports
outlooks.summary: Supply headlines are mixed and the score is near zero. Price is up 15%, and rising anode and feedstock costs are supportive, but there is no clear shortage.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the Deer Park outage and whether the anode price rally continues.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应消息多空交织,评分接近零。价格上涨15%,阳极和原料成本上升提供支撑,但并无明确短缺。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产被焦化装置复产抵消
石油焦上涨及阳极价格走高
运费挤压美国出口
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注Deer Park炼厂停产情况以及阳极价格涨势是否延续。

drivers: Mixed refinery outage and restart news
Petcoke rally above US$100
Index down 5% over 3 months
outlooks.summary: There is no clear shortage signal: outages are small and offset by restarts. The index is down 5% over 3 months after a large 12-month gain.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf Coast refinery outages and freight rates.
outlooks.summary_zh: 缺乏明确的短缺信号:停产规模较小,且被复产抵消。指数近3个月下跌5%,此前12个月涨幅较大。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产与复产消息交织
石油焦升至100美元以上
指数近3个月下跌5%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾沿岸炼厂停产情况和运费。
